description: This file defines a logging utility with an enumeration for log levels and a Logger struct for outputting messages at different severity levels. It also includes an extension to initialize LogLevel from a string configuration value.

methods.name: rank
methods.description: Returns the priority rank of the log level.

methods.name: log
methods.description: Logs a message with a specified log level if it meets the current log level threshold.

methods.name: trace
methods.description: Logs a message at the trace level.

methods.name: debug
methods.description: Logs a message at the debug level.

methods.name: info
methods.description: Logs a message at the info level.

methods.name: warn
methods.description: Logs a message at the warning level.

methods.name: error
methods.description: Logs a message at the error level.
